html:
.timeline {
  min-width: 0;
  container: activity-timeline / inline-size;
}
.scroll {
  overflow-anchor: none;
  max-height: 400px;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
.scroll:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}
.list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.list > li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  min-width: 0;
}
.row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 56px;
}
.main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 64px 96px minmax(160px, 1fr) 88px 64px 64px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  min-height: inherit;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
button.main {
  cursor: pointer;
}
button.main:hover {
  background: var(--surface-hover);
}
button.main:active {
  background: var(--surface-pressed);
}
button.main:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}
.list > li[data-selected="true"] > .row {
  background: var(--selection);
}
.list > li[data-selected="true"] > .row::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--primary);
}
.time {
  font-family: monospace;
}
.agent {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.action {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.action > svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  stroke-width: 1.75;
}
.action > span {
  min-width: 0;
}
.action > span > span {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.action small {
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.status {
  min-width: 0;
}
.duration,
.tokens {
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.expand {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-right: 4px;
}
.expand svg[data-open="true"] {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}
.details {
  max-height: 320px;
  padding: 12px;
  overflow: auto;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 12px/20px monospace;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.details dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.details dt {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.details pre {
  overflow: auto;
}
.timeline[data-compact="true"] .row {
  min-height: 40px;
}
.timeline[data-compact="true"] .action small {
  display: none;
}
@container activity-timeline (max-width: 799px) {
  .main {
    grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) 88px;
  }
  .agent {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 2;
  }
  .action {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }
  .status {
    grid-column: 3;
    grid-row: 1;
  }
  .duration {
    grid-column: 3;
    grid-row: 2;
  }
  .tokens {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 2;
  }
}
@container activity-timeline (max-width: 479px) {
  .main {
    grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr);
    padding-inline: 8px;
  }
  .agent,
  .duration,
  .tokens,
  .action small {
    display: none;
  }
  .action > svg {
    display: none;
  }
  .action > span > span {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .time {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .status {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 2;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .row {
    min-height: 56px;
  }
  .timeline[data-compact="true"] .row {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

.list[data-defer-offscreen] > li { content-visibility: auto; contain-intrinsic-block-size: auto 56px; }
